page.overview:
Who is Million Favoured One?

The Million Favoured Ones are a mysterious group first mentioned in "The Whisperer in Darkness" and expanded upon in the Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.

The Million Favoured Ones are not a true species, but in fact a catch-all term for any entity who has been granted a new, more powerful form by Nyarlathotep as a reward for their patronage.

The Million Favoured Ones include individuals such as the Lurker in the Star Pool and the Horsemen of Nyarlathotep.

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
